title: Checkout Gateway HTTP 504 Downstream Partner Timeout
symptoms: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout on checkout payment submission endpoints
Upstream thread pool exhaustion on API Gateway
root_cause: Downstream payment processing provider experienced regional latency degradation, exhausting local connection threads due to lack of circuit breaker.
resolution: Engaged circuit breaker fallback to secondary payment rail and tightened upstream timeout thresholds.
verification: Checkout gateway latency normalized to 380ms, payment success rate recovered to 99.4%.
